scope: CPU execution of actual notebook input-construction definitions isolated via AST; no GPU imports or inference.
checks: All 1,974 recovered sentences reconstruct the saved original prompts exactly and in the original row order.
All labels and five duplicate text/label rows beyond the first are preserved.
All 5,922 alternative prompts match one application to raw text (three templates x 1,974 rows).
Repeated source keys with the same raw text do not expand held-out rows; literal prompt-like words in original sentences are preserved.
Ambiguous/missing source mappings, missing raw-text fields, invalid split rows, and reordered checkpoint holdouts are rejected.
External XED and EmoEvent inputs remain raw text in their original retained row order.
